title: A1 Level Test
description: Comprehensive A1 test covering all modules. You need at least 8 out of 12 correct to pass.

questions.question: Ms. Lee is the teacher. Which pronoun replaces Ms. Lee?
questions.explanation: Ms. Lee is a female person → she.

questions.question: Complete: Where ___ you from? — I am from Brazil.
questions.explanation: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are + subject.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: Their children ___ young.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/girl, their = plural.

questions.question: Complete: ___ have two cats.
questions.explanation: Most nouns add -s for plural. Learn high-frequency irregular plurals. Verb agreement: one book → it is; two books → they are.

questions.question: Complete: Those buildings ___ old.
questions.explanation: This/these = near the speaker. That/those = farther away. Match number: this/that + singular verb; these/those + plural verb.

questions.question: Complete: We ___ a small car.
questions.explanation: Have with I, you, we, they. Has with he, she, it. Questions and negatives use do/does + base have: Does he have a bike?

questions.question: Complete: We don't ___ any sugar.
questions.explanation: Some in positive statements. Any in questions and negative statements. Some in polite offers and requests.

questions.question: Complete: The keys ___ in the bag.
questions.explanation: Use there is/are for existence in a place; have/has for ownership. Add prepositions for precise location: on the wall, in the bag, at the do
